content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Describe the external and internal structure of the heart
Identify the four chambers and major blood vessels
Explain the functions of heart valves
Describe the blood flow through the heart

is a muscular organ that pumps blood around the body. It beats continuously throughout life - about 100,000 times per day. Understanding its structure helps explain how it efficiently pumps blood through two separate circuits simultaneously.
Size: About the size of your fist
Location: Centre of chest, between lungs
